purpose: Test one fresh broadcast-scale episode as an end-to-end integrated system from state/data-informed planning through surface realization, validation and guarded state commit.
hypothesis: With E1 surface contract and E2 data/full-planning interface fixed, the system can produce one fresh 35,000+ character episode whose planning hierarchy, scene semantics, surface craft, continuity and state delta remain coherent end-to-end without critical validation failure.

sample_scale.sequence_guidance: 9-10 minimum guidance; not a global fixed maximum
sample_scale.scene_guidance: 45-50 minimum guidance; not a global fixed maximum
sample_scale.this_sample_plan: 10 sequences / 50 scenes, chosen for this experiment only

pipeline: DB64 advisory retrieval under E2-qualified interface
claim_boundary: PASS closes E3 only. It does not close E4, E5, E6, Production promotion or Level-3 entry.
